Typo fixed. Force of habit.
Please revert changes in this file, it’s not related to this PR

It is though, this library is extremely out of date and had a fix issued in version 1.7.5 (Magento has 1.7.3) that fixes an issue that prevents unit tests from being executable and has a rare chance to throw in error in general.

It was fixed in 2015, I placed it in the file as a means of correcting the issue: https://github.com/julien-maurel/jQuery-Storage-API/commit/abef0586cf92e29297a283ee6299bac741ae125e#diff-50c51a23ea1ca042039829fb4ddeeb7c

This library had it's final release in May of 2016 (1.9.1) I think it's kind of ridiculous that this library is on a 2014 version, I'm also fine upgrading this library to 1.7.5 or even 1.9.1 (not sure how much divergence there is between 1.7.5 & 1.9.1)

Please advise how you want me to proceed.

I removed it in a commit, you'll be able to see below the results of Magento's Unit Tests running.  But essentially here's what happens:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1484134/88667583-9243ea00-d0af-11ea-96f1-944e9618029d.png)

In general this plugin is buggy for instance it causes issues like https://github.com/magento/magento2/issues/27355  https://github.com/magento/magento2/issues/17195 and https://github.com/magento/magento2/pull/17033#issuecomment-411026073, would be good to get rid of it at some point, but not in scope of this task.
@complexthings please check my comments above, hope it will fix the issue you had

Seems like we have `$` in the top, so probably we should use it instead
```suggestion
            originalGetJSON = $.getJSON;
```
Seems like we don't really need to mock any dependencies, so looks like we can just use customerData object that already imported above. What do you thing?
Are we expecring to have any exceptions here? I don't think it's good to have empty catch, it will just mask any issues inside
